name: mclite
description: A lightweight, generic Minecraft Bedrock storage system: dynamic-property A/B-slot record storage, mirroring, checksums, generic id/owner registries, per-owner indexes, pairwise relationship stores, counters, block links, and pluggable scan/repair/export/import mechanisms. Extracted and generalized from OpenChara's dataCore.js family - see OR-Phase 4 in the project plan.
